edits.old: gives RWB-E2-002, RWB-E2-004, RWB-E2-007, RWB-E2-008, RWB-E2-027 and RWB-E2-035 one catalog row set to read, by rule ID and package version.
edits.new: gives RWB-E2-002, RWB-E2-004, RWB-E2-007, RWB-E2-008, RWB-E2-027 and RWB-E2-035 one catalog row set to read, by rule ID and package version. The three Epic 2 rule packages are read through the contract as the fixture set of this key, and the rwb-comms package assignment is settled with the rule registry owner before the integration stage. The PAYMENT_MATCH package carries the match order EXACT, then PARTIAL, then WINDOW, and this key carries the version label PMT-2026.12 valid from 2026-12-15; its reconciliation with the RWB-E2-027 value (PM-2026.12 valid from 2026-12-01) is open before SIT. The match rows live only in the PAYMENT_MATCH package and no match rule table is created.
